context: A uni student teases a teen friend about a video game tournament
purpose: Teach: ロケット/対決/ゾーン/ビッグ/スタンス/リクエスト/駆使/パチンコ

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 聞いたぞサクラ。今度の格ゲー大会、ビッグマウス叩いてるらしいな。
lines.en: I heard, Sakura. Apparently you're talking big about the upcoming fighting game tournament.
lines.style: Teasing senior tone, casual masculine, light mocking edge.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うるさいなあレン先輩。だって相手、いつも勝てない強豪対決だよ?気合い入れないと無理だもん。
lines.en: Ugh, shut up Ren-senpai. I mean, it's a showdown against rivals I never beat, gotta hype myself up.
lines.style: Whiny teen pushback, defensive but playful, drawn-out vowels.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 気合いだけで勝てるなら苦労しないって。お前、スタンスがいつもブレブレじゃん。
lines.en: If pure spirit was enough to win, nobody'd struggle. Your stance is always wobbling, isn't it.
lines.style: Mocking rhetorical jab, university-aged smirk, dry technical tease.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ブレてないし!ちゃんとキャラの特性駆使して戦ってるんだから。
lines.en: It's not wobbling! I fight properly making full use of each character's traits.
lines.style: Indignant pouting, defensive expertise-flex, slightly raised pitch.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: へえ、立派立派。でも本番で集中ゾーンに入れなかったら、ただの運ゲーだぞ。パチンコと変わらん。
lines.en: Oh, impressive impressive. But if you can't enter the focus zone in the real match, it's just luck. No different from pachinko.
lines.style: Faux-admiring then cutting, dry university humor, deadpan tease.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ひどっ!てか先輩、配信のリクエストで実況やるって言ってたよね?来てくれるんでしょ?
lines.en: So mean! By the way senpai, you said you'd do commentary by stream request, right? You're coming, aren't you?
lines.style: Mock-wounded pivot to begging, teenage manipulation tactic.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: まあ、ベスト8まで勝ち残ったら考えてやる。負けたらそこらのカフェでジュースおごれよ。
lines.en: Well, if you survive to the top 8 I'll think about it. If you lose, treat me to a drink at some random cafe nearby.
lines.style: Conditional bargaining, smug senior leverage, teasing wager tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うわ、足元見過ぎ!絶対勝って先輩を解説席に引きずり出してやるからね。私のコンボ、ロケットみたいに飛ぶよ?
lines.en: Ugh, you're totally exploiting me! I'll definitely win and drag you onto the commentary seat. My combos fly like a rocket, you know?
lines.style: Fired-up declaration, teenage bravado, mock-threatening playful finish.
